work-03.rationale: Homework is schoolwork completed outside class; an assignment is a broader task and is not necessarily homework.

work-04.rationale: A classroom is a room where teaching occurs, while a school is the institution or building.

work-05.rationale: A school principal heads a school; a teacher instructs students. These are different roles.

work-07.rationale: A job interview is a specific employment-assessment meeting, while meeting is a general planned gathering.

work-09.rationale: A company is a business organization; an office is a workplace or physical location.
